name: Primus Mall
tagline: Online mall app bringing local clothing, beauty and lifestyle stores into one catalog
role: iOS and Android app development for an Uzbek online marketplace

scenes.title: Many local stores, one shopping app
scenes.body: Clothing, beauty and sports-nutrition shops share one catalog, with promo banners and new arrivals up front.

scenes.title: A catalog built for browsing
scenes.body: Women's, men's and kids' sections with subcategories, server-driven filters and sorting by price or rating.

scenes.title: A directory of partner shops
scenes.body: Shops are listed as one paged directory; each opens a storefront with banners and an infinite-scroll feed.

scenes.title: Product pages from photo to cart
scenes.body: Zoomable photos, article number and price, a size picker and add-to-cart, leading into a six-step checkout.
